newsitem.title: USA: AT&T given Ohio PUCO's interconnect report.
newsitem.headline: AT&T given Ohio PUCO's interconnect report.

text.p: AT&T Corp said on Tuesday the arbitration panel of the Public Utilities Commission of Ohio issued a preliminary report outlining prices, terms and conditions under which AT&T will interconnect with Ameritech Corp's network and provide local phone service in Ohio.
The company said the report was a step forward even if there were some unresolved issues.

"Although the arbitration panel's report is not entirely what either party asked for, we feel it's a balanced decision and a step in the right direction of giving Ohio customers a choice for local service so that they can start reaping all the benefits of competition," said Ray O'Connell, AT&T public relations vice president.

The panel ordered an aggregate discount for all services of at least 19 percent with several adjustments still to be made by Ameritech. AT&T said its preliminary analysis showed the final discount to be between 20 percent to 25 percent.
AT&T said it asked PUCO on August 1 to arbitrate the unresolved issues in AT&T's negotiations with Ameritech and expected a final arbitration decision by late November.
